basis: Source-known PSS schema and independent editorial proposal; root has inspected only live phase/completion counters, not E25 numeric timing/PSS reports.
per_run_headline: Maximum tree_pss_bytes over ALL external samples with phase_publication_eligible true, retaining phase/time and eligible count; no selection of only steady state.
per_configuration_headline: Range of the three per-run observed sampled maxima for each horizon/worker/arm. Keep all three values and maximum phases in table data.
missing: No eligible sample means unobserved; never substitute zero, another phase, RSS sum, logical bytes, or a completed prior run.
language: Sampled application-process-tree PSS maxima. Not a full-resident representation footprint, memory requirement, simultaneous atomic peak, population uncertainty or cgroup charge.
secondary: Phase-specific maxima and counts may be shown separately; promotion/setup included in headline if eligible.
